summary: Tested the NEW Employer Plans & Pricing feature end-to-end (backend + frontend) plus regressions for ₹199 employer unlock and freelancer landing navigation. All 11 backend tests passed (11/11 = 100%). All 8 required frontend flows passed (100%). The WorkHop kangaroo logo renders correctly on the landing page (image bundled at 640x349, displayed 260x142, HTTP 200, 175KB). Both plan sections A (postings) and B (branding) render 6 cards total with correct prices/badges. Bottom-sheet mock Razorpay flow (UPI/CARD/NETBANKING chips → Pay → success) works, sheet auto-closes after 1.2s, purchased plan appears in the Active Plans strip with correct expiry (e.g. Enterprise Suite: 'Active until 6 Aug' = today+30d). Regressions verified: ₹199 employer unlock still works (unlock-cta → pay-confirm → leads unblur), freelancer landing card still navigates to /freelancer wizard. No blocking issues found.

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking React 19 warning: 'Accessing element.ref was removed in React 19'. Emitted by bottom-sheet during sheet expand. Known upstream; safe to ignore per task note. Reference: /app/frontend/app/employer/plans.tsx and /app/frontend/app/employer/index.tsx (BottomSheet usage).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~670 lines — consider splitting into routers (leads, freelancer, jobs, plans) before it grows further, but not urgent.

plans.tsx and employer/index.tsx duplicate the mock Razorpay bottom-sheet UI (methods chips, upi box, pay button). Consider extracting a shared <MockPaySheet /> component to avoid drift when payment UX changes.
seed_data_creation: Test employer_ids prefixed 'TEST_employer-*' inserted into plan_purchases collection by test_plans.py; also a couple of anonymous unlock records and TEST_Regress freelancer via regression tests. No cleanup done (records are namespaced and harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Plans feature is stable. Backend endpoints verified: GET /api/plans (6 plans, correct sections/prices/badges), POST /api/employer/plans/purchase (200 for valid, 404 for invalid, expires_at set only when duration_days present), GET /api/employer/{id}/plans (isolation confirmed). Frontend testIDs used: landing-logo, employer-plans-btn, plans-banner, plans-topbar, plan-card-<id>, plan-buy-<id>, plan-pay-method-{upi|card|netbanking}, plan-pay-confirm-btn, plan-pay-success, active-plans, active-plan-<id>. Note: container server clock reads Jul 2026 (not Jan) so 30-day expiries render as 'Aug' — this is correct behavior.
